about_the_game:
Soul Astray is a challenging (yet whimsical) puzzle-precision platformer that subtly and playfully touches on the struggle to find direction in one's life. 

  • Difficulty: A minimal tutorial followed by learn-as-you-fail levels that demand creativity.

  • Planning: Use the game's unique Planning Mode that encourages first-try success.

  • Health Tokens: You're an immortal soul that can survive without health, but the tokens might be useful elsewhere...

  • Reset Tokens: If you find yourself stuck due to an earlier misstep, use these limited tokens to restart the level.

  • Goodness Meter: The purity of your soul is tracked, show them (who?) that you have more than just a good heart.

  • Lamps: Sacrifice soul fragments to light the lamps in your path, a gift to help guide other lost souls. If you find a lamp already lit, accept the gift for a unique power.

  • Trinkets: Collect trinkets in hard-to-reach places to remind yourself who you are + alter game outcomes.

  • Secrets: Unexpected secrets encourage you to make choices that can alter your end-goal.

You watch them ascend around you... what will you sacrifice to keep up?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Jump, dash and use abilities granted by your immortal soul to outjump damnation in this challenging, yet whimsical, puzzle-precision platformer. Flex your creativity and precision as you overcome hand-crafted trials with minimal instruction.
